debit.notes: Banking Customer Care toll-free 1800 2080 is published as 24x7 and is the number the debit-card page names for blocking ('You can also block your debit card by calling our Customer Care at: 1800 2080 (Toll-free)'). The fraud-reporting page gives both published numbers for reporting a fraudulent transaction: Banking Toll Free 1800 2080 (24/7) or MFI Toll Free 1800 4200 (7 a.m. to 10 p.m.). Customers calling from abroad are directed to +91 8065 662000. No SMS block format is published. In the mobile app or internet banking (ebanking.jana.bank.in): Services -> Debit Card Management -> 'Block Card' (temporary) or 'Hotlist Card' (permanent), select the card number, enter the OTP sent to the registered mobile number and Submit. The published customer-care email is customercare@jana.bank.in. The bank's site now lives at jana.bank.in (www.janabank.com redirects there). The bank's own pages do not mention the national cybercrime helpline 1930.

credit.notes: No credit-card product or credit-card blocking channel is published: the bank's Cards section lists only the RuPay Debit Card, https://www.jana.bank.in/credit-cards/ returned 404 in the same live check, and the only 'credit card' mentions on the FAQ page are generic mobile-banking copy (e.g. changing a 'debit/credit card pin'). The earlier entry's credit-card numbers (1800-102-3456, 080-6956-8800) appear nowhere on the current official site; the banking customer-care lines under 'debit' are the bank's published reporting channels.

upi.notes: No self-service UPI block/freeze path is published anywhere on the bank's site: no in-app UPI lock (the mobile-banking page's Key App Features table lists Fund Transfer 'Through IMPS-IFSC Code'/'Through NEFT'/'Through RTGS' and Debit Card Management only — 'Temporary Block/ Unblock Debit Card', 'Permanent Block Debit Card' — with no UPI module), no netbanking UPI manage path (FAQ: 'What type of Fund Transfer options are available in Jana Small Finance Bank Internet Banking? NEFT IMPS RTGS'; IB service requests are only 'Configure / Update Email ID, Change Card PIN, Block Card'), and no SMS or *99# USSD keyword for UPI on any page fetched. The nav's 'BHIM - UPI' page (https://www.jana.bank.in/payments/transfer-funds/bhim-upi) returns '404 - Category not found' in the live fetch. The published UPI-relevant channels are on the Report A Fraud page: the form's 'Select your issue*' dropdown includes a dedicated 'UPI transaction' option, and the page instructs 'To report a fraudulent transaction, kindly call our customer care for immediate action. Banking Toll Free Number: 1800 2080 (24/7) OR MFI Toll Free Number: 1800 4200 (7 a.m. to 10 p.m.)' — tollFree is therefore the 24x7 banking line, the same number the FAQ's Security & Safe Banking answer gives for a suspected 'unauthorised transaction' ('report it to the nearest bank branch immediately or email to customercare@jana.bank.in/ you can call us on 18002080'). The bank markets its app as 'Jana Bank - UPI, Pay, Collect' in a slider banner on its own fraud-awareness page (https://www.jana.bank.in/jana-hit-mein-jaari: banner heading 'Jana Bank - UPI, Pay, Collect' over 'Download the app now and start exploring!', with the same store links) but publishes no in-app UPI freeze menu path. The 'UPI QR Code Loan Repayment' page is a loan-repayment QR service only ('For any details call your respective Relationship Manager/Toll Free No.1800 4200'). The bank's pages do not mention the national cybercrime helpline 1930.
